rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: Get the ultimate in Air Cooking Technology and bring fresh options to family dinner this 30-inch, High Speed Preheat 5.0 cu. ft. gas range. Quickly access spills on the cooktop with our industry-first, dishwasher safe EZ-2-Lift(TM) Hinged Cast-Iron Grates. Get crispy and save time with No Preheat Air Fry, and go from gooey to golden and bake evenly on multiple racks with Air Baking. Plus, you can stay on top of the latest cooking features and unlock new ones over time with Smart Feature Updates. *Griddle not included.
rawPayload.Features_Legacy:
• Air Cooking technology
  • Get the ultimate Air Cooking technology and bring fresh options to family dinner with No Preheat Air Fry, Air Baking, Air Broil, Air Roast and Air Reheat.
  • EZ-2-Lift(TM) Hinged Cast-Iron Grates
  • Get quick access to spills with our industry-first, dishwasher safe EZ-2-Lift(TM) Hinged Cast-Iron Grates. The hinged design lets you wipe up underneath without the hassle of removing heavy grates.
  • 10 Cooking Modes
  • Take your favorite meals from fresh, fridge or freezer to fabulous with the Air Cooking Technology of No Preheat Air Fry, Air Baking, Air Roast, Air Broil and Air Reheat, or use traditional Bake, Slow Cook, Broil, Proof, and Keep Warm Cooking Modes.
  • No Preheat Air Fry
  • Save time* with No Preheat Air Fry. Our most advanced air fry mode delivers the right heat at the right time, while using less oil than traditional deep frying. Get fast, crispy, tasty results with No Preheat Air Fry *Compared to WFE550S0LZ
  • Air Baking
  • Go from gooey to golden and get even results when baking on multiple racks with Air Baking. Our high-speed fan optimizes air flow and drives consitent heat throughout the oven. Get golden results on breads, pastries and more.
  • Air Broil
  • Melt, char and sear in a snap with Air Broil. Our high-speed fan drives air flow to drives intense heat directly to the top of the oven. Prepare juicy chops, crispy vegetables and gooey s'mores with the added power of intense air-driven heat.
  • Air Roast
  • Seal in flavours and juices for meat and poultry with Air Roast. Our high-speed fan drives air flow to optimize heat through longer cook times. Enjoy the full flavour of hearty dishes like pot roast and whole chicken.
  • Air Reheat
  • Skip microwaving and add crispness to leftovers like pizza with Air Reheat. Our high-speed fan drives heat to quickly bring food up to temp.
  • No Preheat Mode
  • Take preheating off your plate with No Preheat Mode. Simply place your food in the oven and start baking. The oven will adjust the cook time for frozen pizzas and more.
  • Proof Cycle
  • Designed to maintain a low temperature, the Proof Cycle provides ideal conditions to properly activate yeast allowing your baked goods to rise.
  • Keep Warm Setting
  • Use the keep warm setting in the oven to help your dishes stay warm until your family is ready to dig in.
  • Griddle Zone
  • Get nearly 3x more griddle space* than an 8"" skillet and more power than the leading range. Easily cook and flip a variety of foods like pancakes, meats, and veggies.
  • SpeedHeat(TM) Burner
  • Use the SpeedHeat Burner to boil 20% faster* with high heat, so you can get dinner to the table quickly. *Compared to 9.5K burner on the same model.
  • Cooktop Flexibility
  • Easily cook multiple dishes at once with a flexible cooktop that offers a range of element sizes and power levels.
  • Dishwasher Safe Air Fry Basket Included
  • For easy cleaning, put the included Dishwasher-Safe Air Fry Basket right in the dishwasher when it gets messy.
  • Smart Range
  • When you re busy elsewhere, use your smartphone to get dinner started by remotely preheating the oven. Or, when your hands are full, use your compatible voice-enabled device to adjust the cook time or temperature with a voice command.*
  • Smart Feature Updates
  • Stay on top of the latest cooking features and unlock new ones over time. Explore more ways to cook with Smart Feature Updates through the Whirlpool app.* Appliance must be connected. WiFi & App Required. Features subject to change. Details and privacy info at whirlpool.ca/connect.
  • Steam Clean
  • Use the Steam Clean setting to quickly and easily loosen light messes inside the oven without harsh chemicals or cleaners-just add water, run the cycle and wipe away.
  • Self Clean
  • Easily clean your oven with the adjustable Self Clean cycle that can be customized based on the amount of spills and splatters.
  • Anti-Fingerprint Stainless Steel
  • Available in a stainless finish that s easy to clean and resists fingerprints and smudges.
  • Sabbath Mode
  • Sabbath mode keeps the oven in Bake mode until it can be shut off, allowing you to cook and warm food during the Sabbath. All other oven settings, including temperature displays, sounds, changes in light status and cleaning cycles will be disabled.
  • Max Capacity Rack (Sold separately)
  • Make the most of your oven with Max Capacity Rack (sold separately). When you're cooking for a crowd, this rack has a step design that creates additional space for deeper dishes or a larger turkey.

product.description:
Get the ultimate in Air Cooking Technology and bring fresh options to family dinner this 30-inch, High Speed Preheat 5.0 cu. ft. gas range. Quickly access spills on the cooktop with our industry-first, dishwasher safe EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged Cast-Iron Grates. Get crispy and save time with No Preheat Air Fry, and go from gooey to golden and bake evenly on multiple racks with Air Baking. Plus, you can stay on top of the latest cooking features and unlock new ones over time with Smart Feature Updates.

Features:

  • 5 cu. ft. capacity meets the needs of today's busy homes
  • This range comes equipped with 5 sealed burners
  • Touch controls are precise and easy to use
  • Range includes viewing window, griddle, broil element, and storage drawer
  • Easily cook multiple dishes at once with a flexible cooktop that offers a range of element sizes and power levels
  • Easily clean your oven with the adjustable Self Clean cycle that can be customized based on the amount of spills and splatters
  • Use the Steam Clean setting to quickly and easily loosen light messes inside the oven without harsh chemicals or cleaners—just add water, run the cycle and wipe away
  • For easy cleaning, put the included dishwasher-safe air fry basket right in the dishwasher when it gets messy
  • Enjoy plenty of space to sauté?, boil and simmer with Edge-to-Edge Cast-Iron Grates and the flexibility of a cooktop with a range of burner sizes and power levels
  • Covered under a 1 year limited parts and labor manufacturer warranty

Product Technologies:

  • No Preheat Mode: Take preheating off your plate with No Preheat Mode. Simply place your food in the oven and start baking. The oven will adjust the cook time for frozen pizzas and more.
  • Air Baking: Go from gooey to golden and get even results when baking on multiple racks with Air Baking. Whirlpool's high-speed fan optimizes air flow and drives consistent heat throughout the oven. Get golden results on breads, pastries and more.
  • Griddle Zone: Get nearly 3x more griddle space* than an 8"" skillet and more power than the leading range. Easily cook and flip a variety of foods like pancakes, meats, and veggies with included griddle.
    *Compared to the leading brand’s best selling model. Based on reported BTU output
  • Air Broil: Melt, char and sear in a snap with Air Broil. Whirlpool's high-speed fan drives air flow to drives intense heat directly to the top of the oven. Prepare juicy chops, crispy vegetables and gooey s'mores with the added power of intense air-driven heat.
  • Air Cooking Technology: Get the ultimate Air Cooking technology and bring fresh options to family dinner with No Preheat Air Fry, Air Baking, Air Broil, Air Roast and Air Reheat
  • Air Reheat: Skip microwaving and add crispness to leftovers like pizza with Air Reheat. Whirlpool's high-speed fan drives heat to quickly bring food up to temp.
  • Air Roast: Seal in flavors and juices for meat and poultry with Air Roast. Whirlpool's high-speed fan drives air flow to optimize heat through longer cook times. Enjoy the full flavor of hearty dishes like pot roast and whole chicken.
  • EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged Cast-Iron Grates: Get quick access to spills with Whirlpool's industry-first, dishwasher safe EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged Cast-Iron Grates. The hinged design lets you wipe up underneath without the hassle of removing heavy grates.
  • SpeedHeat™ Burner: Use the SpeedHeat Burner to boil 20% faster* with high heat, so you can get dinner to the table quickly (*compared to 9.5K burner on the same model)
  • Smart Range: When you’re busy elsewhere, use your smartphone to get dinner started by remotely preheating the oven. Or, when your hands are full, use your compatible voice-enabled device to adjust the cook time or temperature with a voice command.*

    *Appliance must be set to remote enable. WiFi & App Required. Features subject to change. Details and privacy info at whirlpool.com/connect

Specifications:

  • Total Capacity: 5 Cu. Ft.
  • Back Left Burner BTU: 10,000
  • Back Right Burner BTU: 5,000
  • Front Left Burner BTU: 18,000
  • Front Right Burner BTU: 18,000
  • Broil Element: Yes
  • Convection: No
  • Self Cleaning: Yes
  • Depth: 28"
  • Height: 47-7/8"
  • Width: 29-7/8"
